name: wispay-e2e-coverage-improvement
description: Conduct end-to-end browser testing with Playwright across canonical routes, measure test coverage, and improve codebase quality (lint, types, tests, components, pages) to meet all quality gates. Deliver e2e evidence bundle, coverage report, and a list of codebase improvements requiring approval.

tasks.subject: Define e2e test scope and codebase improvement targets
tasks.description: Requirements analysis for e2e browser testing scope and codebase improvement targets. Identify canonical routes to test, coverage goals, and specific codebase quality issues to address (lint warnings, type errors, missing tests, UI inconsistencies).
tasks.objective: Define the e2e test scope (routes, viewports, assertions), coverage measurement plan, and a prioritized list of codebase improvements for the engineer to implement.
acceptance: A requirements document is produced listing all canonical routes to test at both 1440x900 and 390x844
A coverage measurement plan is documented showing which modules need coverage
A prioritized list of codebase improvements is documented (lint, types, tests, components)
Dependencies are identified for downstream implementation tasks
tasks.output: Defined comprehensive E2E test scope covering all 17 canonical routes (15 registered + auth flow + error pages + unknown route) at desktop (1440×900) and mobile (390×844) viewports. Identified 5 existing E2E test files with 9 tests covering ~40% of routes. Documented 9 new test files needed (error routes, auth routes, dashboard, finance review, payments, admin, audit, reports, responsive contract) and 3 existing files to extend. Full scope documented in `.scratch/wispay-e2e-coverage-improvement/e2e_test_scope.md` with per-route checklists, design system compliance requirements, environment setup, and security invariant assertions.

acceptanceResults.criterion: All canonical routes identified and mapped
acceptanceResults.evidence: 17 routes mapped from routers.py ROUTES tuple + auth flow + error pages + unknown route

acceptanceResults.criterion: Existing E2E test coverage gaps identified
acceptanceResults.evidence: 5 test files, 9 tests found; gaps in 7 routes (finance-review, payments, admin, audit, reports, login, signup) plus error pages and auth flow

acceptanceResults.criterion: E2E scope documented with per-route checklists
acceptanceResults.evidence: Scope written to .scratch/wispay-e2e-coverage-improvement/e2e_test_scope.md with desktop+mobile viewport matrix, design compliance, accessibility, browser error capture, and security invariant checks

tasks.subject: Start Reflex dev server for e2e testing
tasks.description: Start the Reflex dev server with explicit ports (frontend 3000, backend 8000, host 127.0.0.1) and demo mode enabled. Verify the server is running and responding before proceeding to browser tests. This is a prerequisite for all e2e browser tests.
acceptance: Reflex server starts without errors on the specified ports
Frontend at http://127.0.0.1:3000 responds with HTTP 200
Backend at http://127.0.0.1:8000 responds correctly
Demo seed is active (WISPAY_DEMO_MODE=1)
tasks.output: Starting Reflex dev server with demo mode and auth bypass. Checking environment setup and dependencies first.

tasks.subject: Run Playwright e2e browser tests across canonical routes
tasks.description: Run Playwright browser tests at desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) for all canonical routes: dashboard, requests, request-detail, new-request wizard, approvals, finance-review, payments, admin, audit, reports, login/auth routes. Capture accessibility snapshots, screenshots, console errors, and network failures for each route. Use the playwright-cli skill with the configured Playwright MCP.
acceptance: All canonical routes are tested at both desktop and mobile viewports
Accessibility snapshots captured for each route
Screenshots captured for each route
Console errors and network failures recorded
No horizontal scroll at any viewport (scrollWidth <= innerWidth)
Route-specific assertions pass per the test_ui_smoke.py patterns

tasks.subject: Measure test coverage and identify gaps
tasks.description: Measure test coverage by running pytest with --cov on the WisPay package. Identify coverage gaps in services, states, models, and pages. Compare against the existing test suite to determine what's already well-covered vs. what needs improvement.
acceptance: Coverage report generated showing line/branch coverage for WisPay package
Coverage gaps identified in services, states, models, and pages
Prioritized list of modules needing additional tests created
Baseline coverage numbers recorded for comparison after improvements
tasks.output:
Coverage baseline report generated. 246 tests pass (9 e2e deselected). Overall coverage: 78% (4,652 stmts, 1,022 missed). 

Key findings:
- Services: 81% avg (sql_repositories.py at 47% is the worst)
- Models: 92% avg (well-covered)
- States: 62% avg (lowest tier — approvals.py at 30%, request_create.py at 38%, request_tracking.py at 34%)
- Pages: 60% avg (approvals.py at 59%, request_detail.py at 60%, requests.py at 62%)
- Components: 77% avg (form_fields.py at 26%!)

Report saved to tests/test_coverage_baseline.md with prioritized lists.

commandsRun.evidence: 246 passed, 9 deselected, 24 warnings. Coverage HTML report at htmlcov/. Baseline report at tests/test_coverage_baseline.md

tasks.subject: Audit codebase for lint, type, and format issues
tasks.description: Run ruff lint, ruff format check, and mypy on the entire codebase to identify existing warnings and errors. Cross-reference issues with CONVENTIONS.md and AGENTS.md standards. Produce a prioritized list of fixes to apply.
acceptance: Ruff lint issues catalogued with file/line references
Ruff format issues catalogued
Mypy type errors catalogued with severity
All issues cross-referenced against coding standards
Prioritized remediation plan created
tasks.output:
Lint/type/format audit complete. Full report at tests/test_lint_audit.md.

Results:
- Ruff lint: PASS (zero issues across entire repo)
- Ruff format: PASS (214 files already formatted)
- Mypy WisPay + states: PASS (zero issues, 99 source files, strict mode)
- Mypy tests/: 1 issue (tests/services/fakes.py module naming conflict — missing __init__.py)
- Mypy scripts/: 10 errors in 2 files (smoke_approval_flow.py and db_diagnose.py — API mismatches, untyped params, string literals vs enums)

Issues in scripts/ and tests/ are outside the current CI gate (validate.sh only runs mypy WisPay). Remediation plan created with 3 tiers: 6 scripts fixes (Tier 1), 1 tests fix (Tier 1), and future hardening suggestions (Tier 3).

commandsRun.evidence: Success: no issues found in 99 source files
10 errors in 2 files: smoke_approval_flow.py (7 errors) and db_diagnose.py (3 errors)

tasks.subject: Implement codebase improvements (lint, format, types, tests)
tasks.description: Implement the codebase improvements identified in t5 (lint fixes, format normalization, type annotation fixes) and add missing tests identified in t4. Focus on improving test coverage for services, states, and models. All changes must follow CONVENTIONS.md and AGENTS.md standards.
tasks.objective: Improve codebase quality by fixing lint warnings, format issues, type errors, and adding tests to increase coverage
acceptance: All lint warnings resolved or documented
All format issues fixed
All mypy errors resolved or documented
Test coverage increased by at least 5% from baseline
New tests follow existing testing patterns and pass validation

tasks.subject: Re-run validation and e2e tests after improvements
tasks.description: Verify all changes by re-running the full validation suite (ruff lint, ruff format, mypy, pytest) and re-running e2e browser tests against the running server. Capture updated screenshots and compare with baseline. Ensure coverage has improved.
acceptance: All validation checks pass (lint, format, types, tests)
E2e tests pass with no new failures compared to baseline
Coverage report shows improvement from baseline
No console errors or network failures in e2e run

tasks.subject: Code review of all improvements
tasks.description: Conduct a code review of all changes made during this engagement. Review against Standards (CONVENTIONS.md, AGENTS.md, coding conventions) and Spec (whether changes match the requirements). Produce a side-by-side review report with findings, verdict, and any remaining gaps.
tasks.objective: Review all codebase changes for compliance with WisPay coding standards and verify implementation matches requirements
acceptance: Code standards review completed with verdict
Spec compliance review completed with verdict
All findings documented with file/line references
Remediation recommendations provided for any issues

tasks.subject: Compile final e2e evidence and coverage improvement bundle
tasks.description: Compile the final deliverable bundle: e2e evidence (screenshots, accessibility snapshots, console/network logs), coverage report comparison (before/after), code review results, and a summarized list of all codebase improvements made. Present the bundle to the user for approval.
tasks.objective: Produce a complete evidence bundle showing e2e test results, coverage improvements, and code review outcomes
acceptance: E2e evidence bundle compiled (screenshots, accessibility snapshots, console/network logs)
Coverage improvement report with before/after comparison
Code review results summarized
All deliverables presented to user in a clear, organized format
